text:
deploy-bot: Progressive rollout started for release v3.2.1 -> prod, target: 10% of traffic (global). changelog: https://ci.redwood/changes/v3.2.1 :rocket:
alice: watching metrics, @jamal will you take the lead on infra side?
jamal: seeing a 4xx spike in eu-west1 around +3m after canary started. error rate ~2.1% vs baseline 0.2%.
priya: tailing logs now. initial glance shows repeated kv-cache miss + worker OOMs on a few hosts.
dani: can we pause the rollout while we investigate?
alice: please pause canary, hold for decision. not allowing percent increase.
deploy-bot: Canary hold requested by alice. Rollout paused at 10%. No further traffic migration.
jamal: dug into logs — kv-cache header absent for some sessions, leads to fallback allocation spike. likely quantization change in v3.2.1.
priya: confirmation — reproducer in staging with same settings. quick patch available but needs new image build (~20m).
dani: options: 1) rollback the 10% cohort to v3.2.0, 2) keep paused and wait for patch. rollback minimizes customer impact.
alice: recommend rollback for affected cohort now, then patch and re-run canary during next change window. @oncall please standby for monitoring.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated to v3.2.0 for canary cohort (10%). Executing pool drain -> replace.
oncall: monitoring on. will watch error-rate, latency, and OOM alerts for 15m.
jamal: post-rollback: error rate back down to ~0.22%. OOMs no longer showing.
priya: will open a release branch with the kv-cache header guard and add an integration test. ETA ~25m.
dani: adding a brief note to release notes and the postmortem checklist.
alice: great work — rollback complete, canary paused, patch in flight. next steps: patch + small canary tomorrow in the 02:00–04:00 change window. I'll pin the version on the affected route until we validate. :thumbsup:
priya: ack. will post PR and link update here when ready.
deploy-bot: Noted. Notifications sent to oncall and product. Canary cohort remains at v3.2.0.
